171)༄༅'od gsal snying gi thig le'i dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi smin byed ye shes mchog stsol bzhugs/ngag la ngag gi dbang thob pas/dpal ldan yon tan

tei:div.tei:p: 'od gsal snying gi thig le'i dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi smin byed ye shes mchog stsol bzhugs/ ngag la ngag gi dbang thob pas/ dpal ldan yon tan bye bas phyug mkhas btsun bzang po'i khyu mchog che/ 'gro ba'i bla ma de la 'dud/ de yi zhal lung bdud rts-i'i skyes/ mchog thun grub pa'i sgo gcig pu/ dbang drag rdo rje gro lod kyi/ smin byed ye shes mchog stsol bri/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su ras bris khro dkyil rta babs brgyad la/ khyams gru chad/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rnams phyogs mdog zla gam dmar po/ chos 'byung mthing gar lha gnas sku'i phyag mtshan thig le bris pa'i dbus mañja'i khar dpal gtor brjid ldan dmar po thebs kyu lha grangs/ sku tsag dang dar gdugs mthing gas brgyan pa/ thod chang chos sman mngar gsum sbyar ba/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi mchod pas bskor pa dang*/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril/ thod rnga/ las bum/ thun snod sogs kyang 'du bya/ dngos gzhi la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du song nas/ dkarabagegs/ mtshams bcad/ skyabs sems nas/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas dang*/ las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis brlabs/ bka' srung tshogs bsgral bstab yan 172) zin nas/ bdag nyid 'jug pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin nam sgyu 'phrul ltar rig pa'i me tog dor/ gnang bzhod/ slob ma rnams sgo khar khrus nas dbyungaḥ nang du zhugs nas bgegs la gtor ma sbyin nas bskra*/ srung 'khor sgoms/ me tog bkye bsdu dang*/ chos bshad mtshams sbyor rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa las/ skabs su babs pa 'dir ni mkha' 'grau'i snying tig las/ gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs su: lcags sgrom lta bu'i yul gyi stod: 'brong bu mnyal 'dra'i dpyi stengs su: mkha' 'gro sde lngas byin brlabs pa'i: sa khams yos lo ngag gi dbang:

spro ring theg chen chos la mos: sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin zhing: ma 'gags spyod pa sna tshogs spyodaḥ ces dang*/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ lan cig ma 'ongs dus kyi tha mar yang: gsang ba'i mtshan 'dzin bzang po'i ming can dag: dgongs 'dus thugs sras yang dag mchog don ldan: yos lo lte sme lha sras bla ma'i tshul: bstan pa bsrung skyob 'gro ba mang zhig 173) 'dren: gsang sngags nges don thabs lam gnad dang ldan: bstan pa 'gro don lho nas lho ru dar: dgongs 'dus bka' chen lung gi bdag por 'gyur: zhes dang*/ rat+na'i gter lung las/ klu sgrub sprul pa bstan pa'i bdag nyid 'dzin: bzang po'i ming can glang ngam yos lo pa: bstan la phan pa khams kyi phyogs su 'byung: zhes rdo rje'i lung gis yang nas yang du bsngags pa'i skyes pa rabs kyi phreng ba yang*/ dang po'i rigs can drwa ma lnga las li tsa bi dri med grags pa/ dge slong blo 'chang slob dpon klu sgrub ste ston pa'i lung zin gsum/ zla ba grags pa/ chos gyi grags pa/ slob dpon bstan pa ste 'phags yul mkhas pa gsum/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ hūm̐ chen kā ra/ bi ma mi tra ste rnal 'byor dbang po gsum/ gcog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po ste bod yul lo tsā gsum/ 174) rgyal po rnam gnon/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ bstan pa tshe ring ste chos kyi rgyal po gsum/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ go rams bsod nams ye shes/ mkhas btsun ye shes 'bum pa ste bod yul mkhas pa gsum/ mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ grub thob karma gling pa ste rig 'dzin gter ston gsum/ rje btsun rat+na ya ti/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug mkhas grub karma chags med de bya bral rnal 'byor gsum sogs mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug gcig dang du ma'i 'phrul gyis skye ba'i phreng bar bzung zhing*/

sku tshe 'dir yang mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod btsun pa'i yon tan grub pa'i mngon rtogs/ mdzad pa'i phrin las sogs phyogs yongs nas lhun gyis grub cing*/ khyad par pan chen bi ma la lo rgya re'i mtshams su bod la byon pa'i mngon rtags shangs rtser a yig gis mtshan pa kun 175) gyi mthun snang du grub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod las 'das pa kun mkhyen bla ma ngag gi dbang po dpal bzang po'i 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le'i chos skor babs pa cung zad gtan la phab pa ste/ rang gzhung las/ 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas bka': 'jigs med gling pa'i chos sde yin: de dus brda 'di ma pheb bzhag: zhing skyong lha mor gnyer gtang nas: ma 'ongs snyigs ma bdo ba'i dus: nga yis rjes 'dzin nga yi bu: rig pa hur la btul zhugs can: rang byung gdings dang ldan pa'i bus: brda 'grol 'gro la sman gyur shog: da dus shing sbrul dkar po'i mjug: bstan zhabs sdud pa'i he ru yis: snyigs ma'irlung nag g.yos pa'i dus: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul yig gi: brda 'di zhing skyong lha mos bstan: brda 'grol las kyi rdo rjes so: 176) zhes gsungs pa'i nang tshan che mchog pad+ma drag po rdo rje gro bo lod kyi skor te/ de'ang phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje nus mthu mdzad phrin yon tan thams cad gcig bsdus su byin gyis brlabs nas 'gro ba'i 'dren par bsngags pa gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes sku gsum ston pa'i zhi khams rab 'byams rgya mtshor mtshan dang sku'i rnam 'gyur gcig tu ma nges shing sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rol mos 'khor ba ji srid de srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las/ zhing 'dir yongs su grags pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal/ legs sbyar skad du kro dha lot+ta ra ste khro bo 'jig rten mchog ces 'jig rten gyi khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi khro rgyal chen po'i skur bstan pa/

sgra de zur chag pa'i nges don mdo sngags zung 'jug gi sku'i chas las rdo rje gro bo lod de 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po 'di ni slob dpon chen pos thog mar bsam yas kyi sa gzhi 'dul ba'i skabs dang*/ 177) bar du bdud blon rnams kyis sku la bsdo bar brtsams pa'i dus dang*/ mthar rnga yab pad+ma 'od du gshegs khar mon spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug pa sogs khams bod kyi stag tshang ming can bcu gsum du rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas mi dang mi ma yin gdug cing gtum pa thams cad tshar bcad cing rjes su bzung nas dam la bzhag pas mtshon/ bod yul gyi gdul bya mi srun pa rnams 'dul ba'i sku'i bkod pa ni 'di kho nar bstan pa shas che ste/ rang gzhung las/ sil ma la dang 'u yug mal gro klung*/ has po ri dang sham po mkha' ri dang: ti se gangs dang mchim phu shel brag dang: mkhar chu bsam yas khra 'brug la sogs dang: khyad par stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod skur bstan te: bod yul mtha' dag gter gyi gtams byas nas: zhes dang*/ gter kha gzhan las kyang*/ e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: rang gi sgrub pa rang gis brtsams: su 'phrad bde chen 178) zhing la sbyor: zhes dang*/ khyad par byin rlabs dngos grub myur 'dod na: rdo rje drag rtsal pad+ma nga nyid sgoms: dus gsum sangs rgyas yon tan bdag la rdzogs: nga nyid sgom dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang: rgyal ba zhi khro gsang sngags phyi nang dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'-i byin rlabs dngos grub rnams: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod kun tshang ltar: de dag ma lus thams cad bdag la rdzogs: nga nyid sgom dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang: rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje de la gzigs: gsang sngags phyi nang lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dbang bskur byin rlabs dngos grub ster bar byed: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin ltar du: bka' srung chos skyong thams cad bran ltar nyan:

snang srid lha 'dre thams cad bka' bzhin sgrub: yon tan thams cad nga nyid bsgoms las byung: dngos grub thams cad nga nyid bsgoms pas 'thob: phrin las thams cad nga nyid bsgoms pas 'grub : ces dang*/ bdud 'dul gro lod las/ ma 'ongs nga yi rjes 'jug kun: 'di nyid nyams su sus blangs pa: 'jig rten dregs pa ma lus 'dul 179) ba dang: khyad par rgyal bsen dam sri thams cad dang: 'jig rten log gshed bdud rigs ma lus kun: srog snying phul zhing bran du 'khol: bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par 'gyur: mngon sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu thob: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i gang zag kun: skad cig tshe 'di nyid la ni: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin sa la ma 'god na: pad+ma nga yis phyi rabs skal ldan bslus pa yin: de phyir nyams su longs shig nga yi rjes 'jug kun: 'on kyang dus ngan sems can las ngan dbang che bas/ sbyangs pa sngon song skal ldan re 'ga' tsam re ma gtogs pa/ 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skyes bu shin tu dka': dper na me tog u dum+bā ra dag dang mtshungs: yang zab 'di nyid 'phrad pa'i skyes bu shin tu dkon: dper na nyin mo'i skar ma dag dang mtshungs: 'di nyid sgrub mchod sus byed pa: pad+ma 180) nga nyid dngos yin pad+ma'i bka': 'jig rten dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba dang: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin sa la 'god 'dod na: snying thig zab mo 'di nyid nyams su longs: snying thig 'di 'dra 'jig rten gsum na dkon: bden brdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: dkon mod khal khams 'grim dang gsal: zhes phan yon mtha' klas pa mnga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la sogs mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni: kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can: srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam byang ba: de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter: gtso bos bdag la bka' drin rtsol:

lan gsum/ kun bshags bya ba ni/ bshags yul mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i spyan sngar gnyan po stobs bzhi tshang bas/ ho: dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsol: ma rig rmongs pas ldong ba'i skye 'gro dang: rnal 'byor ma la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po: thog ma med pa'i dus 181) nas da bar du: gzung 'dzin chags pa'i dbang gis bsags pa yis: rgyu drug bag chags ji snyed ma lus dang: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: zhes bshags pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ so byang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par lhag pas bsdus ba thams cad bsrung bar dam bca' pa ni/ ho: ma rig rlabs kyis sems nyid rang zhal sgrib: ye nas dbyer med rtog pas so sor gzung: rang byung 'du 'bral med pa'i rdo rje sems: sku gsung thugs su bsgrub par dam bca' 'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gcun pas lha bskyed yongs rdzogs bton te gsal 'debs pa phyag bzhes su mdzad la/ tshig lhug pas gsal gdab na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las yi ge hūm̐ yig dmar po pad+ma ra ga ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du nam mkha' rlung khrag keng rus sa gzhi ri rab me ri dang bcas pa'i khar/ rdo rje me dpung dur khrod pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal med khang phyi rin po ches nang bhan+dha las grub pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad ldan chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang bcas pa'i dbus phyur bur rdo rje rin po che'i tog tshad dang mtshan nyid ma tshang ba med pa/ rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ nang bar khyams gru chad 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte ba chos 'byung 'bar bar/ sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma bdud dang dam sri bsnol ba'i steng du dmu stag mi zan shin tu 'jigs pa'i gdan la 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po dbang drag khros pa rdo rje gro bo lod sku mdog mthing nag bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i ri rab nyi ma bye bas 'khyud pa lta bu/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal am gtsigs sdom zhing mche ba gtsigs pa'i ljags las 'od zer 'phro ba/ 183) spyan gsum las bskal me 'bar zhing smin ma glog ltar 'khyug pa/ shangs nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub pa ag tshom sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ ral pa kham nag rdo rje'i tshom bur 'khyil ba las me rlung 'phro ba/ snyan cha dang dung long rdo rje'i khong gseng las 'brug sgra sgrog cing rdo rje'i thog char 'bebs pa/ ber phyams dmar smug chos gos dmar po rnam pa gsum gyis bklubs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga gnam lcags ral gri 'bar ba las rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ g.yon lcags phur 'dril ba las lcags sdig nag po ser ltar 'bebs pa/ zhabs sag lham dang bcas pa'i 'dor stabs kyis stag mo'i mgo dang 'phang steng brdzis pa 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ thugs kar zla gam dmar po'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' pad+ma he ru ka dbu lnga pa g.yas dkar g.yon 184) ser rgyab ljang steng mthing sku dang rtsa zhal dmar ba zhal re re bzhin rta mgo ljang khur dkar po phur bu ser po rngog ma dmar po las bzhi'i mdog can 'tsher ba/ phyag rgya bcu drug gi g.yas pa brgyad na/ rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wām̐/ dril bu/ lcags kyu/ sbrul zhags/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ g.yon pa brgyad na/ thod khrag pad+ma/ ru tra'i snying*/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ rgya gram/ pe con/ me dpung*/ tri shu la dang*/ ye shes kyi khyung khra 'gyed pa rdo rje'i khyung gshog rtse na khyung dang nyi zlas mtshan pa/ dur khrod dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs pa/ zhabs brgyad g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi 'gyings ba'i pang du yum pad+ma gzi ldan mthing ga nor bu za ma tog bsnams pa dang sbyor ba/ gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu bud+dha thod phreng rtsal dmar smug rtsibs bzhi'i shar du badz+ra thod phreng rtsal dkar po/ lhor rat+na thod phreng rtsal ser po/ nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dmar po/

byang du karma thod phreng rtsal 185) ljang gu/ lnga ka'ang g.yas ḍā ru g.yon rang rtags rigs lnga'i phyag rgya/ phod ka cod pan dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gru chad bzhir rigs bzhi'i ging chen las bzhi'i mdog can rang rtags dang bhan+dha/ gsang ba'i yum bzhi gri thod 'dzin cing gcer bu rin chen rus pas brgyan pa pad+ma baṃ ro gar stabs su 'gying ba/ bar khyams su gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'grau 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang*/ sgo skyong phyag rgya bzhi ldan rgya chen pho nyar 'gyed pa/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod dkyil 'khor gyi sku phyag rgya/ gsung sngags phreng*/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa kha char bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin spyan drangs te snying ga 186) nas sib sib thim pas

rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'imos pas/ las byang gi spyan 'dren nam byin 'bebs tshig dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar oṃ dz+nyā na a be sha ya a āḥ sogs brjod pas byin dbab/ de brtan pa'i phyir tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dngos bzhis la maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol pa gdab pa ni/ phung po khams dang skyed mched tshogs: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs su dag sbyor bas: phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig: gtor mas dbang bzhi bskur ba la/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zair rim par gyur te gnas gsum du thim pa dang: khyad par gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pas snod bcud dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ye nas gzhir bzhugs su gyur pa gzhir bzhengs su gsal 'debs pas hūm̐ hrī: bh+rum̐ skyes gtor ma lha yi gzhal yas khang: yid 'ong rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: bcud kyi dam pa gtso bo thabs shes dang: mtheb kyu 'khor tshogs sprul pa ging gi tshogs: skal ldan bu la gtor mas dbang bskur bas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: sku yi 187) byin rlabs slob ma'i lus la zhugs: bde ba chen pos lus la dbang bskur bas: na tsha sdug bsngal 'khrul pa'i snang zhen sbyangs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya ni rma ṇa ka ya bha ling+ta a bhi ṣiñca ā: des lus kyi las dang rtsa yi sgrib pa dag: sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob ཿ bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur: rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: sprul sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag: gtor ma 'grin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi byin pas 'gyu ba'i rlung khams mtha' dag grags stong sngags kyi 'khor lor rdzogs par mos pas/ hūm̐ hrī: bde gshegs yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: dri med bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang chen po: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gsung: gsung gi byin rlabs slob ma'i ngag la zhugs:

rmad byung mi shigs gsung sgras dbang bskur bas: sgra skad zhen rtog sngags la dbang bskur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya: saṃ bho ga ya kā ya 188) bhing tā a bhi ṣiñca ā: de'i rjes 'brel du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ slob ma'i mgrin pa nas zhugs/ snying gar 'khor bar mos pas rjes gnang sgrubs sngags rnams rjes zlos bya/ des ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag: gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs: gsang ba'i dbang thob: bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur: tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag: gtor ma snying gar bzhag pas khams 'bar 'dzag la brten pa'i zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar mos pas / hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun gyi grub pa 'od gsal ba: 'pho 'gyur med pa ye nas rgyal ba'i thugs: rmad byung gtor ma shes rab ye shes dbang: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i thugs: skal ldan slob ma'i sems la dbang bskur bas: sems kyi 'khrul rtog 'od gsal chen por dag: skye 'chi med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog la sbyor: sku gsum rtogs 189) pa 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya dharmā ka ya bhing ta a bhi ṣin+tsa ā: des yid kyi las thig le'i sgrib pa dag: thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs: shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: bde stong tsaṇ+ḍa li'i snod du gyur: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: chos sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag: gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag pas thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs snying dbus su sbar bar mos pas / hūm̐: tshad med rmad byung thugs rje'i gtor ma 'di: dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che: dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten: mi zad sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dag pa'i lhar snang 'od gsal du bsdus pas byung: tshor ba'i spros pa 'gags pa'i rig pa rang gnas kyi sems mngon du 'char ba ngo shes pas: hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'khor lo 190) ma lus pa: ma skyes sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thim: chos rnams rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi ngang: ye shes lnga rdzogs stong nyid dam pa'i mdzod: a a a: zhes dgongs pa bskyangs/ des kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag: ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs: tshig gis mtshon pa don dam gyi dbang thob: ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur: lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag go: shis pa brjod/ dam tshig khas blang ba ni/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang: yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga: med dang cig pu 'chal ba sogs: cho ga bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi: btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod bla ma'i phyogs su gtong ba/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' rtsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyiḥ khyod la bdag kyangayongs su 'bul: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: dge ba bsngo ba slob ma rang gnas su 191) btang*/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang ba man spyi ltar ro/ las kun grub pa gtor ma'i dbang bzhi la// brten nas sad rmi gnyid 'thug snyoms 'jug gi// bag chags sbyangs te lam bzhis rig 'dzin bzhi*// bgrod nas sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog /zhes zab lam 'di nyid kyi chos sgo thog mar 'byed pa'i snod ldan du gyur pa rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dusapa rtsal gyis kun mkhyen bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// 192)
